title: Eigenvalue powers for a finite compactification
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime different from its characteristic, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and f₀:X₀→Y₀ a map of finite-type D.k₀-schemes with Y₀ quasi-separated. Let c=(j,p) be a compactification whose proper part is finite. For any constructible common-stage Weil sheaf F, closed y of Y₀ and β∈Ω which is an eigenvalue of local Frobenius on the specified R⁰p_*j!F at y [def-weil-punctual-weights, def-zl-weil-compact-support-cohomology], there exist a closed point x of X₀ mapping to y and a nonzero natural number e such that #κ(x)=#κ(y)^e and β^e is a local Frobenius eigenvalue of F at x. This is independent of all weight bounds and all embeddings in C.

source.place: clause (2), finite stalks and Frobenius cycles; parent DAG Steps 7--9, before the absolute-value calculation

proof.text: Unpack the finite Weil presentation and nonzero eigenvector witnessing SfPunctualEigenvalue at y. Apply the finite-stalk evaluation and return theorem to this very presentation and residue embedding. Joint injectivity guarantees a nonzero evaluation component; otherwise the eigenvector is zero.

The power of an endomorphism on its eigenvector multiplies by β^e. Apply the chosen linear evaluation and its return identity to obtain F_x(ev(v))=β^e ev(v). The nonzero component is therefore an eigenvector with eigenvalue β^e. Its recorded finite Weil presentation witnesses SfPunctualEigenvalue on F; the comparison supplies the image point, nonzero degree and cardinality equation.

lean.statement:
theorem sfFiniteCompactificationEigenvalues
    [QuasiSeparated Y₀.hom] (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) (c : Compactification f₀.left)
    [IsFinite c.g] (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω)
    (y : {y : Y₀.left // y ∈ closedPoints Y₀.left}) (β : Ω)
    (hβ : SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Ω Y₀
      (zlWeilHigherShriek D l hl Ω f₀ c 0 F) y β) :
    ∃ (x : {x : X₀.left // x ∈ closedPoints X₀.left}) (e : ℕ),
      f₀.left x.val = y.val ∧ e ≠ 0 ∧
        Nat.card (X₀.left.residueField x.val) = Nat.card (Y₀.left.residueField y.val) ^ e ∧
        SfPunctualEigenvalue D l hl Ω X₀ F x (β ^ e)
